title: CLO releases zFab fabric measurement kit: an innovative AI-driven fabric digitization system + introduction to the booking website.
description: We have heard your voice! A more precise, smarter, and efficient digital fabric solution — the CLO zFab fabric measurement kit, has made its grand debut! Equipped with CLO AI technology, it is designed to accelerate the fabric digitization process. Early users have praised it highly: sampling speed has significantly increased, and collaboration across teams and industries has become more efficient. Learn more about the highlights of the CLO zFab fabric measurement kit and start your digital fabric journey 👉 http://zfabkit.clo3d.com/

summary: ```markdown # Introduction to the Closy Fab Kit Hello friends, Welcome to my channel! Today, I will show you how to make a beautiful fabric measurement experience. ## Meet the Team Hey, I'm Kay, Head of Research at Closoal. And I'm Mason, a 3D Design and Implementation Specialist. Hi, I'm Justin, 3D Design and Implementation Lead at Closoal. ## Exciting Announcement So it's finally happening—the moment you've all been waiting for. We are excited to introduce our new Closy Fab Kit! For many of us at Clos, it's been quite the journey getting here, and we can't wait to share it with you. ## User Feedback and Commitment Since our last fabric launch, we've received tons of feedback from you. You made it clear that while the hardware is useful and important, what really matters is the quality of our service, especially the training and support. Thank you for your input! With this new release, we're committed to maintaining the highest standard of user support. We also heard you loud and clear on what needed improvement. The devices were tricky to use, manual measurements took forever, and user error was affecting the quality. Moreover, you wanted a texture scanning solution that fits smoothly into the Clos ecosystem, and existing options out there were pricey. ## Introducing the Clos Z-Fab Kit Clos made a new Clos Z-Fab Kit based on all the feedback we've received so far. This kit minimizes the human error that occurs in manual measurements and introduces innovative features that improve the process. ### Key Features 1. **Z-Fab Cutter** Presenting the Z-Fab Cutter, which lets you cut fabric samples uniformly every single time. No more struggling with small scissors! 2. **Z-Fab Draper** The Z-Fab Draper uses deep learning AI to automate and simplify the measurement process. This means quicker and more accurate analysis of fabric properties. 3. **Z-Fab Scanner** Lastly, the Z-Fab Scanner is Clos' very own affordable fabric texture scanner that is perfectly integrated with our software. Texture scanning is now easier, faster, and more seamless for Clos users. ## Availability The new Clos Z-Fab Kit will be rolling out in Q4 this year for our enterprise and educational institution clients. If you're interested in getting your hands on it, reach out to your regional Clos reps. ## Conclusion I'm happy to finally show you these new devices. I know that many of you have been waiting for this. Thank you for your valuable advice and feedback. If it wasn't for your help, the upgraded Clos Z-Fab Kit wouldn't have come out into the world. With enhanced automation, accuracy, and speed, we are confident that the new Clos Z-Fab Kit will make your workflow even faster and easier. We can't wait to hear how the new kit works for you, so we can keep making it even better. Let us know what you think! On behalf of the Clos team, thank you for your interest and support for the Z-Fab Kit. ```
